name: CrisisMatch
tagline: Tracks ships and planes near disasters and matches the right volunteers to the need.

awards: Best Beginner Data Science Track Hack

problem: Responders struggle to match help to crises in time.
solution: Real-time ship and flight tracking, weather and market data; three AI models debate severity, then volunteers are matched automatically.
demo_moment: Team-described: a disaster appears and volunteers are matched.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Beginner Data Science Track Hack” among 223 submissions.
